title: A2CN DeliveryNoticeMessage
description: Seller confirmation of delivery against a completed A2CN session. Normative at Level 3 conformance as of v0.2.0 (OQ-017 resolved).

transaction_record_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the agreed transaction record

delivery_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when delivery occurred

delivery_reference.description: Tracking number, PO reference, or other delivery identifier
